title: Submission of Quarterly Report by Consumer Mediation Cell

content.scenario: A consumer mediation cell in a district submits its quarterly report to the District Commission, highlighting the number of consumer disputes resolved through mediation and the details of the cases pending or disposed of.
content.outcome: The District Commission reviews the quarterly report and assesses the performance of the consumer mediation cell. The Commission may provide feedback or guidance to the cell to improve its functioning and effectiveness in resolving consumer disputes.

user_queries: What is the purpose of submitting quarterly reports by consumer mediation cells?
Who reviews the quarterly reports submitted by consumer mediation cells?
What information is included in the quarterly reports submitted by consumer mediation cells?
